items.title: Joseph 'One Eyed Babe' Phillips Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: I'm not playing many dance with him because he was playing trumpet... Ricard was playing, uh, for playing bass

ctx.x: Yeah. Ricard is playing one of those, huh? Ricard. Ricard, no. Ricard Amplopom. No, that's another one. I know, long time when I first found out, I'm not playing many dance with him because he was playing trumpet. Uh-huh. And he got on the bass.
Yeah, how's he got to do?
